sections.executive_summary: The United States launched a new wave of strikes against Iran targeting military objectives near the Strait of Hormuz, with explosions reported in Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Qeshm, and Sirik. Iranian officials state 35 citizens have been killed in July attacks with Hormozgan, Sistan and Baluchestan, and Khuzestan most affected. points: The U.S. military opened a new wave of attacks against Iran with targets being military objectives serving against ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, according to U.S. Army Central Command (Source: @N12chat/217637). The U.S. military stated it launched a new wave of strikes against Iran, with daytime strikes marking a potential escalation versus prior evening and overnight-only attacks (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5011).

Explosions were reported in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, including near Golestan neighbourhood, with multiple blasts at 22:30, 22:31, 22:35, 22:36, 22:37, and 22:38 local time shaking buildings and windows (Source: @VahidOnline/77122). A third wave of apocalyptic U.S. attacks on Ahvaz was reported as having begun (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76375).

A U.S. aggression was reported again on Bandar Abbas in southern Iran with two explosions heard toward the air base and airport at 1:40 AM on July 25 (Source: @mamlekate/103905). Enemy projectile impacts occurred near Sirik at 55 minutes past midnight Thursday attributed to American enemy projectiles (Source: @SharghDaily/172259).

Points near Qeshm were struck by American enemy projectiles with further report pending initial assessments (Source: @SharghDaily/172262). Sounds of several explosions were reported in Chabahar (Source: @kianmeli1/89181). An anti-air drone was targeted and downed in East Azerbaijan Province (Source: @naya_foriraq/83307).

Iran's Health Ministry reported 35 compatriots martyred in July attacks as of noon, with Hormozgan, Sistan and Baluchestan and Khuzestan most affected (Source: @SharghDaily/172255). A missile launch was reported from Kermanshah city (Source: @New_security8200/202642).

IRGC Spokesman Brigadier General Mohebi stated the enemy should not assume it can sustain the current conflict course and turn it into war of attrition; Iran's operations focus on destroying US offensive military infrastructure in the region (Source: @presstv/198916). Intense AA activity was reported over Khorzogh, Isfahan Province (Source: @shin_persian/7944).

U.S. officials told WSJ Trump leans toward expanding military operations in Iran including intensified strikes, seizing Kharg Island with U.S. ground forces, and bombing nuclear-linked Pickaxe Mountain tunnel complex (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5014). A source close to Iranian negotiators claimed Trump planned air attacks and ground invasion backed by Arab regimes (Source: @pkpoi/143307).

The IDF killed two Hamas Nukhba Force commanders in northern Gaza Strip in a precise aerial strike: Ali Shamlakh, deputy Nukhba company commander who advanced attacks on troops and civilians, and Nasser Louh, Sabra Battalion cell commander (Source: @idf_telegram/24643). The military said both posed immediate threat to forces and were eliminated (Source: @manniefabian/58790).

The IDF eliminated a terrorist who took part in the kidnapping of Lt. Col. Asaf Hamami, Sgt. Maj. Tomer Achimas, and Sgt. Kiril Brodsky in the October 7 massacre (Source: @New_security8200/202629). No location or date of elimination was specified in the message.

The government approved a mechanism for state participation in costs of Israeli airline companies for empty flights conducted due to safety, security and operational restrictions during Operation 'Ariel' (Source: @N12chat/217641). Compensation up to 55 million shekels was reported for the airlines.

The Knesset finally approved the law to weaken the role of the Attorney General, with coalition rebels voting in favor at his request; the AG will no longer be able to argue in High Court against the government (Source: @yediotnews25/132742). The law limits the power of the legal advisor (Source: @amitsegal/63093).

Hundreds of youth and pre-military recruits marched from Paris Square to the Knesset in a stretcher march protesting legislation for draft exemption, calling for service for all (Source: @yediotnews25/132743). The central rally was held opposite the Knesset with hundreds of protesters.

A Border Police officer in the traffic division was investigated by police internal affairs on suspicion of obstructing the murder investigation of Beniahu Razi in Nachlaot, Jerusalem, meeting suspects without reporting (Source: @yediotnews25/132737). A five-year-old girl was killed by a vehicle strike in Jerusalem (Source: @yediotnews25/132732).

Forces jumped to Maale Levona area following report of three suspects including an armed one, with several gunshots heard in the area (Source: @inon_yttach/9487). A 10-year-old child was moderately injured in a traffic accident on Giborim Street in Haifa with three lightly injured evacuated to Rambam (Source: @N12chat/217636).

The IDF attacked in northern Gaza Strip and eliminated two Hamas Nukhba commanders: Ali Shamlakh, deputy Nukhba company commander who trained terrorists planning attacks against Israeli civilians and forces, and Nasser Louh, Sabra Battalion Nukhba cell commander (Source: @idf_telegram/24643). The terrorists were eliminated in a precise aerial strike and posed immediate threat.

Southern Command forces are deployed in the area per agreement and will continue to act to remove any immediate threat, according to IDF Spokesperson (Source: @idf_telegram/24643). The strike occurred on Tuesday night in the northern Gaza Strip.

No additional Gaza or West Bank operational military developments were explicitly stated in the provided messages beyond the northern Gaza strike and the October 7 kidnapping perpetrator elimination (Source: @New_security8200/202629).

A five-year-old girl was killed by a vehicle strike in Jerusalem, and a Border Police officer was investigated over obstruction in a Jerusalem murder case in Nachlaot (Source: @yediotnews25/132732). These are criminal rather than conflict operations.

The proposal to commemorate October 7 events was removed from agenda by the Knesset, drawing criticism from 'Future for the Envelope' movement (Source: @yediotnews25/132734). No operational Gaza details were included.

The strike was reported as an air strike on Bint Jbeil area previously used as Hezbollah terror stronghold (Source: @yediotnews25/132738).

Warplanes were reported flying in southern Lebanon with maximum caution urged (Source: @redlinkleb/31475). A loud sound in the south was attributed to enemy detonation in Deir Sryan (Source: @redlinkleb/31389).

Most observed villages for drones were Kfar Tibnit 13, Nabatieh al-Fawqa 12, Ali al-Tahir 12, Burj al-Barajneh 7, Haret Hreik 7 (Source: @redlinkleb/31466). Signal sweep noted for South Lebanon with extreme caution (Source: @redlinkleb/31354).

sections.threat_assessment: The United States has initiated a broadened strike campaign against Iranian military infrastructure near the Strait of Hormuz, with confirmed impacts in Ahvaz, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Qeshm, and Sirik and 35 Iranian deaths reported. IRGC spokesmen warn the current course will not become a war of attrition and that Iran is focused on destroying U.S. offensive infrastructure, implying further Iranian retaliation against U.S. assets in the Gulf. Reports of cruise missiles targeting U.S. ships near Oman and a hit on U.S. bases in Kuwait indicate the conflict is expanding beyond Iran's borders. Trump's consideration of seizing Kharg Island and bombing nuclear tunnel complexes would markedly raise escalation risk across the Persian Gulf.
sections.regional_response: Arab regimes in the Persian Gulf are implicated by an Iranian source as backing a planned U.S. ground invasion, with a threat that those regimes would not survive such a move, raising existential tension in Kuwait, Oman, and Gulf states. U.S. aerial refueling flights over the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz indicate sustained forward deployment by American forces. Vance publicly urged negotiation with Iran against endless bombing, reflecting internal U.S. debate. Lebanese border areas remain under Israeli strike pressure with daily drone and artillery activity, showing spillover into the Levant.
sections.intelligence_notes: Open-source Telegram channels indicate a shift to daytime U.S. strikes on Iran versus prior evening-only attacks, a sign of escalation per U.S. military own framing. Iranian casualty figures of 35 as of noon are attributed to the Health Ministry and should be treated as official claims requiring corroboration. Israeli elimination of two Nukhba commanders in northern Gaza demonstrates continued targeted air operations under Southern Command deployment per agreement. Reported explosions in Ahvaz across repeated timestamps suggest sustained wave attacks; however, some claims of 'apocalyptic third wave' are unverified channel assertions. Gulf base hits in Kuwait and Oman shipping threats warrant monitoring of U.S. force protection posture.
